min_degree.note: The exact minimum degree d: every vertex has at least d neighbours and some vertex has exactly d. It requires a vertex, so K0 has none; it is unique, exists for every graph with a vertex, is the greatest lower bound, is at most Delta and below the order, holds for regular graphs with a vertex and for complete graphs K_{n+1} at n, and is preserved by isomorphisms; the witness-first presentation is equivalent.
